result_semantic_payload.summary: Three CRM orders are confirmed by the payment processor's settlement log via verbatim order-id linkage: ORD-70231 (wangqiang, 20000 USDT, paid) confirmed by the 2024-06-01 settlement order=ORD-70231 wallet=TXabc111 amount=20000 ok; ORD-70232 (zhaolei, 15000, paid) confirmed by the 2024-06-01 settlement order=ORD-70232 wallet=TXdef222 amount=15000 ok; and ORD-70233 (sunli, 31500, paid) confirmed by the 2024-06-02 settlement order=ORD-70233 wallet=TXghi333 amount=31500 ok. Linkage is the exact order_id string shared between the settlements.log 'order=' field and the CRM orders.csv order_id column, corroborated by identical amounts and paid status, per the README rule that settlements reference CRM order ids verbatim. Two entries must stay separate from the confirmed CRM orders: (1) the 2024-06-02 settlement order=ORD-72033 wallet=TXjkl444 amount=9999 ok, whose order id does not exist in the CRM table and therefore cannot be treated as the same order as ORD-70233 despite the near-identical id; and (2) CRM order ORD-70234 (qianer, 8000, cancelled), which has no settlement entry and is not confirmed by the settlement log.

claim_candidates.text: CRM order ORD-70231 (buyer wangqiang, 20000 USDT, status paid) is confirmed by settlement log entry '2024-06-01 settle order=ORD-70231 wallet=TXabc111 amount=20000 ok' via verbatim order-id match with matching amount 20000.

CRM order ORD-70232 (buyer zhaolei, 15000 USDT, status paid) is confirmed by settlement log entry '2024-06-01 settle order=ORD-70232 wallet=TXdef222 amount=15000 ok' via verbatim order-id match with matching amount 15000.

CRM order ORD-70233 (buyer sunli, 31500 USDT, status paid) is confirmed by settlement log entry '2024-06-02 settle order=ORD-70233 wallet=TXghi333 amount=31500 ok' via verbatim order-id match with matching amount 31500.

Settlement log entry '2024-06-02 settle order=ORD-72033 wallet=TXjkl444 amount=9999 ok' must stay separate from CRM orders because order id ORD-72033 does not exist in the CRM orders table and cannot be treated as the same order as ORD-70233.
CRM order ORD-70234 (buyer qianer, 8000 USDT, status cancelled) must stay separate from the confirmed set because no settlement log entry references it and its status is cancelled.
The linkage between the settlement log and CRM orders is the verbatim order id: settlements reference CRM order ids exactly as they appear in the CRM order table, as stated in README.txt.

limitations: Analysis is based on preview-level file content; the three files are small (153-283 bytes) and were fully previewed, but no byte-level hash verification was possible (md5 fields are empty).
The settlement log provides dates only (2024-06-01, 2024-06-02) with no time-of-day, so intra-day ordering of settlement entries cannot be established.
File mtimes (epoch 1790594136) reflect capture time and do not align with the in-log 2024 dates; log dates were used as the authoritative event dates.
No registry, event-log, prefetch, or amcache artifacts exist in this task scope, so execution/persistence corroboration is not applicable to this question.
